verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an API-key-authenticated REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, plus scriptable one-line and Docker Compose installs, so it can be driven and deployed without the UI. Nothing documents a CLI or CI integration for running or testing flows, and API keys are limited to the Platform/Enterprise editions. missing for 10: documented CLI or CI integration (e.g. GitHub Action) for running or testing flows, headless flow-execution workflow guidance, API-key access outside Platform/Enterprise editions, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The API uses "API keys" to authenticate requests.
you can pass the API key as a Bearer token in the header
Activepieces publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (84 paths, server https://cloud.activepieces.com/api)
One line writes the config, generates your secrets, and starts everything.
